paper.title: H2HMem: A Multimodal Memory Benchmark for Agents in Human-Human Interactions

evidence.paraphrase: Dyadic and multiparty interactions test recall, reasoning, and application across modalities, participants, and sessions.

rationale.SP: Partial for the audio panel: participant attribution is scored through text/image QA and RET; supplied speaker IDs do not test acoustic speaker tracking.
rationale.AC: Absent: inputs comprise participant IDs, text, and images. No audio or acoustic-cue task is specified.
rationale.RP: Partial: cross-session Knowledge Resolution tests revised facts, an indirect repair proxy; there is no spoken-repair protocol or verification of persistent repair-state mutation.

manuscript_table_annotation.caveat: The requested repository family is retained for consistency. This source evaluates text/image conversations, not acoustic memory.
